channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: Riverview Landscapes acquires Unisource Commercial Landscape in Massachusetts
item.description: As part of the transaction, Unisource’s commercial landscaping and cleaning operations will combine to form Riverview’s new Boston Metro West branch.

item.title: SDLG North America to showcase new electric, diesel UTVs
item.description: The company will showcase the UTVs at CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026, held this week in Las Vegas.

item.title: WAC Lighting founder earns Long Island Business News Icon Award
item.description: The winners will be recognized at a celebration on March 19.

item.title: New Holland Construction expands D-Series range with 5 new diesel mini excavators
item.description: These join the previously released E42D and E50D models from 2025.

item.title: JCB debuts 250T compact track loader, 25Z mini excavator at ARA Show
item.description: The 250T offers a 74-horsepower engine that powers the machine to a rated operating capacity of 2,429 pounds.

item.title: Stihl launches dealer-focused online marketplace powered by Mirakl
item.description: The new marketplace aims to provide customers with more product availability while enabling fulfillment on orders from over 10,000 authorized Stihl dealers.

item.title: Disney celebrates three decades with senior landscape architect
item.description: Carla Shuman's Disney experience began as a part-time contractor in the Landscape Architecture department over 30 years ago.

item.title: SiteOne launches new LESCO products
item.description: The portfolio includes new herbicides, fertilizers and a battery powered self-propelled spreader.

item.title: Hittle Landscaping acquires Wesley's Landscape & Lawncare
item.description: The partnership with Wesley’s marks Hittle’s second add-on acquisition since CID Capital’s investment in September.

item.title: Lawn and Landcare in Texas launches redesigned website
item.description: The platform introduces improved navigation, streamlined service descriptions and a more intuitive inquiry system.
